rules.trend_pullback: EMA50 > EMA200, ADX >= 25, price reclaims EMA20 after pullback, RSI 45..70
rules.range_breakout: Close crosses previous 20-bar high, EMA50 > EMA200, volume >= 1.5x previous 20-bar mean
rules.mean_reversion: ADX < 20, price reclaims lower Bollinger band (20,2), RSI < 45
rules.macd_momentum: DIF crosses above DEA (12,26,9), EMA50 > EMA200, volume >= previous 20-bar mean
rules.volatility_breakout: Close crosses previous 20-bar high after prior Bollinger width <= prior rolling 100-bar 20th percentile, volume >= 1.5x mean

notes: Rules are research hypotheses, not best-strategy claims.
Development history reused; obtain fresh future paper results.
Final 20% excluded from indicator computation and selection unless candidate qualifies.
Single position; next-open execution, conservative same-bar stop priority, close-updated trailing effective next candle.
Fees 0.1% and slippage 0.05% per side; no order book, exchange precision or minimum order model.
No machine learning training or live orders in this version.
